rv.q: The portrait of human fragility and resilience is timely and powerful.
The company’s slow burning artistry does the talking in a way that transcends words.
This is nevertheless a visual feast which focuses on the sounds and beauty of nature, and beguiles and provokes because of, not in spite of its verbal silence.

cn.t: Critics acclaim Blue Raincoat's wordless, visually stunning environmental meditation. Shadow puppetry and impressionistic stagecraft deliver a poignant climate message that transcends language.
